title: One Thing After Another
gist: Paywalled teaser for a Gavekal quick-hit list covering a crowded week of events beyond Brazil's market-moving election: an Anthropic IPO slated for the week of November 16, Zelenskyy accepting a ceasefire along current lines, Iran-Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan strategic talks, a China rate cut Gavekal says is not really one, China enforcing a crackdown on offshore trust structures, and India possibly changing its long-term capital gains tax. The teaser lists the events without giving the analysis.

insights.claim: Gavekal Research flags that in late October 2026, alongside Brazil's election and the wild market moves after it, several other market-relevant events landed together: Anthropic announced an IPO for the week of November 16, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan held strategic talks, and British Columbia and Israel held elections.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Diary item: watch for Anthropic IPO supply hitting the AI/tech complex in the week of November 16, and for a possible regional security alignment among Iran, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan.
insights.quote: Anthropic announced an initial public offering for the week of November 16.
insights.locator: It has been a busy week

insights.claim: Gavekal Research reports that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced Ukraine would accept a ceasefire and peace deal along the current lines of effective control, and cross-references this to a piece titled 'Shudders In The Tech Complex', which implies Gavekal links a Ukraine settlement to pressure on tech stocks.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: A Ukraine peace deal may rotate money out of tech/defense-adjacent winners and into cyclical or European reconstruction plays, so don't treat it as purely risk-on for tech.
insights.locator: It has been a busy week

insights.claim: Gavekal Research says China cut interest rates 'though not really' (a cross-reference to 'Switching The Policy Rate' suggests a change of benchmark rather than real easing). It also says China began enforcing a crackdown on offshore trust structures while India, going in the opposite direction, announced it may change its long-term capital gains tax structure.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Don't read China's headline rate cut as meaningful stimulus, and watch India's capital-gains change as a possible driver of flows into or out of Indian equities while China tightens control over offshore wealth.
insights.quote: China cut interest rates… though not really
insights.locator: It has been a busy week
